assessment: Design documents and a runnable core exist. The demo illustrates the prototype; it does not certify the complete design, risk review or mockup deliverables.

The recording demonstrates branch selection, persisted application state and a join. Package sourcing uses pinned repository packages. The live composer is sequential; full branch/join back-office coverage and the proposed provider journey remain gaps.

The direct composition recording executes financing and review through the common interface. Private approval is a separate ownership/continuation reference. Neither recording establishes an external deployment.

The build recording checks a compiled adapter and unchanged source DAR; a separate generated-integration run executes the workflow. Direct and generated paths share the core. These are bounded repository examples, not arbitrary DAR support.
Selected permission, join, duplicate and rollback outcomes demonstrate specific boundaries. The broader internal hardening suite is still required; these scenes are not complete M5 acceptance.

Runnable references and local release tooling exist. This portable replay is an evaluation artifact. Provider integration, full dapp scope, release publication and knowledge transfer are not established by it.
External evidence required: two qualified adopting teams and their confirmations. A local demo cannot satisfy this milestone.
External evidence required: additional qualified adoption beyond M7. No adoption or committee acceptance is inferred from repository tests.
